1. Short title.- This Act may be called the Gwadar Industrial Estates Development Authority Act and it extends to the notified area.
25. Offences.- An offence punishable under the Pakistan Penal Code (Act XLV of
1860) shall be dealt with in the manner provided in that Code and the offender shall be liable accordingly.
26. Power to make rules.- The Government may make rules for carrying out the purposes of this Act.
4. Commencement.- The earlier notification (
2001) dt. 16.12.2001 shall stand repealed and shall cease to have effect from the appointed day hereafter.
5. Savings.- Anything duly done under the repealed notification shall continue in force until it is altered by the Authority.
3. Amendment.- In the Stamp Act (
1930), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, section 2 shall be amended in the manner following and shall have effect.
